scope: Attendance-only continuation of the site-wide debug; local synthetic verification, not a hosted deployment certificate

safety.browserContexts: Dedicated headless Chromium contexts, external browser requests blocked, owned contexts/browser/local HTTP server closed in finally
safety.database: In-memory PGlite only; fixture never reads env files and supplies explicitly synthetic backend credentials

findingsFixed.before: A delayed monthly or annual confirmation captured the previous selected-year load callback. Changing YEAR before completion let that callback supersede the new request and install old-year data under the new YEAR label. Another confirmation could also replace the shared pending state.
findingsFixed.redEvidence: The actual client from immutable base 2325abb6f0e25cf74b91b2b06f5f901712df359d passes real save/reload and failed retry, then fails the held API/SQL save plus year-change regression: OPEN count 0 instead of 1.
findingsFixed.fix: Record selected-year ownership in refs updated synchronously by the only year setters; invalidate in-flight load IDs on selection; stale callbacks return before issuing a new read. Serialize monthly/annual confirmations using a synchronous pending ref and disable other confirmation buttons until settlement. Monthly pending identity includes year.
findingsFixed.greenEvidence: Seven actual-page/guard browser groups pass, including both monthly and annual held confirmation/year changes; four actual-page to real-route to constrained-SQL to real-GET groups pass. Failed storage leaves SQL unchanged, successful retry persists, and saved confirmation survives a full page reload.

findingsFixed.before: The automatic confirmation helper checked only third Hong Kong working day. Although the normal cron is scheduled at 18:00 HKT, an authorized earlier execution could confirm before the promised deadline.
findingsFixed.redEvidence: Actual helper with only database boundary synthetic incorrectly returns skipped=false and writes at 2026-11-03T16:00:00Z (00:00 HKT on third working day). New cutoff test failed before the guard; two adjacent helper tests passed.
findingsFixed.fix: Require current time at or after the same day's 18:00 HKT timestamp using the existing date/time helpers, in addition to third-working-day validation.
findingsFixed.greenEvidence: Four actual-helper tests pass: before18 skip without attendance reads/writes; exact18 inclusive; persisted holiday shifts day; existing personal confirmation untouched; pending update retains status=pending predicate; repeated18:15 run changes neither actor nor first timestamp.

ownershipAndTimeProof.actualApiAndDataHelpers: View self-confirmation succeeds only for exact signed-in admin_user_id plus active person. Other person's ID, pending/reset status, no linked user, inactive person, edit/reminder/sync actions and no-access requests are denied. Editor exceptions remain.
ownershipAndTimeProof.hongKongBoundary: Actual confirmation API/helper tests prove September becomes confirmable at 2026-09-30T16:00:00Z and December at 2026-12-31T16:00:00Z, not UTC midnight. Current/future months remain denied for both View and Edit.
ownershipAndTimeProof.fullFlow: Actual AttendanceRecordClient and AdminRouteGuard; actual attendance GET/POST route; actual attendanceData ownership, validation, upsert, monthly read and calculations; real PostgreSQL table constraints extracted from repository migrations; persisted row assertions; actual GET and browser reload. Only authentication/user directory/email/sync/Supabase-transport boundaries are synthetic.

commands.immutableRed: Append --baseline-client-ref=2325abb6f0e25cf74b91b2b06f5f901712df359d to persistenceBrowser; expected failure at held save/year-change assertion, without changing workspace sources

results.immutableRaceBaseline: Expected red reproduced on exact released client; first two persistence groups pass, held save/year switch assertion fails 0 !== 1
initialInvocationCorrections: Initial TypeScript API invocation without --conditions=react-server failed importing server-only, not application logic; corrected command passes.

Repository ESLint global react-hooks rule is not configured for CJS. Including browser CJS files in lint fails plugin resolution; TS/TSX lint and CJS node syntax/runtime checks pass. No shared config changed.
New annual browser coverage first exposed a fixture-only th selector assumption; annual rows use td. Selector now covers th and td before final green runs.

limitationsAndUnchangedPolicy: No real hosted database, production cookies/session resolution, email delivery, or scheduled job was exercised. Root owns hosted verification and deployment.

PGlite full-flow uses actual foundational table definitions and confirmation uniqueness/check/FK constraints, but does not claim parity with hosted RLS, audit, backup fencing or source-invalidation triggers. The automatic-confirm helper's repeated-run proof uses stateful synthetic DB responses, not a hosted cron run.
Disputes remain the documented direct-contact-with-administrator workflow; no dispute form or dispute API exists in this scope.
Year-end confirmation still reuses the December confirmation row with annual-summary note, as before. This change does not redesign or separate annual acknowledgement storage.

Independent tabs still use the existing confirmation upsert semantics; this patch prevents overlapping operations within one page but does not add cross-tab compare-and-swap or immutable confirmation history.

The automatic helper still runs only on the third Hong Kong working day; this patch does not add next-day catch-up after a whole-day missed schedule. Holiday accuracy depends on the persisted Event Calendar.
The mounted page's current month/year is initialized on load as before. An open page crossing midnight/month-end should be refreshed; server cutoff/closed-month validation remains authoritative.
